title: tone-check: add a shared tone reviewer for generated replies
body:
## Summary
Skills in other plugins cannot check the tone of a generated reply with one shared reviewer.

## Proposal
1. Under the condition that a skill passes a reply to the reviewer, the reviewer returns a list of findings, each with the sentence and the reason.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A reply with a harsh sentence returns one finding that names that sentence.

title: tone-check: ship a script that flags harsh wording
body:
## Summary
No script flags harsh wording in a generated text file.

## Proposal
1. Under the condition that a text file is given, print each harsh word found.

Shipped in release v2.3.0 as `scripts/check_tone.py`. Run `python3 scripts/check_tone.py <file>`; it prints one JSON object with `status` and `findings`.
